content.thinking: `_NAME` is the result of `re.compile(...).fullmatch` — a bound method ✓ which IS callable... Hmm, "TypeError: 'int' object is not callable" — so `_NAME` is an int! Because `_POS, _NAME, _TEXT, _WIRE, _PAIR, _UNIT = range(6)` comes AFTER the `_NAME = re.compile(...)` assignment and overwrites `_NAME` with the int 1! Let me rename the regex to `_NAME_RE`.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('driver.py').read()
src = src.replace("_NAME = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}').fullmatch",
                  "_NAME_RE = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}').fullmatch")
src = src.replace("_NAME(name)", "_NAME_RE(name)")
src = src.replace("_NAME(value)", "_NAME_RE(value)")
open('driver.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 launch.py < /tmp/req.json && echo && cat /workspace/examples/sanity.json | python3 launch.py; echo; python3 public_check.py
